title: France Bond Collapse Implodes EURO; China Russia Gas Deal Stuns; Japan Begs For Rare Earths
speaker: Sean Foo

macro_themes.view: Riots and 5% French yields leave France no way out; ECB bailout (TPI/OMT) increasingly likely.
ECB money printing to rescue France will weaken the euro and worsen Europe's energy inflation.
Power of Siberia gas deal accelerates de-dollarization and RMB-settled trade.
China's control of yttrium leaves Japan's chip and jet-engine industries exposed.

calls.reason: Traders front-run expected ECB bond buying for France; euro already down ~4% vs dollar.
calls.quote: investors, they fear a bailout. They fear the euro is about to fall even harder.

notes: Macro commentary; only the euro has a directional market view.
